editorial:
Imagine stepping into a professional kitchen where the pressure is so high it feels like a war zone. You follow Jeanne, a young and hungry cook who is desperate to make it in the fancy world of high-end French cooking. She gets a job under a world-famous chef, but she quickly finds out that the price of success is more than just hard work. The vibe is intense and stressful, making you feel every cut and every burn as she tries to survive the brutal rules of the kitchen. It is not a cozy cooking show; it is a fight for survival where your mental health is on the line.

The acting is top-notch, especially the way the tension builds between the students and the master chef. You will love how it shows the gritty side of cooking, though the slow build-up might feel a bit heavy for some. If you enjoy stories about obsession and ambition, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: At the end, you see that Jeanne has completely changed. She has become just as cold and mean as the chef she once feared. She finally earns the respect and position she wanted, but she lost her kindness and soul to get there. The movie wraps up by showing that the cycle of abuse in the kitchen just keeps going, with Jeanne now becoming the boss who puts others through the same pain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes dramas and stories about the dark side of success.
